backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report describing two content updates to siteContent.ts for plot lists in Hateberia JL 167 and Radhaballabchak JL 165.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of all frontend files describing components, styles, content, and new structured property details feature.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and custom OKLCH theme variables for light and dark mode styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app composing header, hero, content sections, property details, documents, and footer.
frontend/src/components/DocumentsSection: Renders document list or empty state using siteContent with icons and styled cards.
frontend/src/components/PropertyDetailsS: Displays structured property records with khatian badges, collapsible plot lists, totals, and notes.
frontend/src/components/Section.tsx: Reusable layout wrapper providing section titles and consistent spacing.
frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx: Footer with disclaimer, copyright, and caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx: Sticky header with scroll state, navigation, and mobile menu supporting smooth section scrolling.
frontend/src/content/siteContent.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces for documents and property records and exports the site's main structured content object.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user’s Internet Identity and auto‑invalidates dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication provider and hook handling login, logout, identity loading, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder file for future React Query hooks that will call backend actor functions.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global Tailwind layers, custom CSS variables for the site's earth‑tone theme, and base typography styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers and loads global styles.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with dark mode, theme extensions, custom colors tied to CSS variables, fonts, and plugins.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, existing features, requirements, and architectural notes for the site.
